facts: The perception of transparent objects from images is a very hard problem in vision.
Given a single image, detecting the presence of transparent objects in the scene is difficult.
The paper explores what can be said about transparent objects by a moving observer.
Features that are imaged through a transparent object behave differently from features that are rigidly attached to the scene.
The paper presents a novel model-based approach.
The approach recovers the shapes of transparent objects from known motion.
The approach recovers the poses of transparent objects from known motion.
The objects may be composed of multiple layers.
The multiple layers may have different refractive indices.
The simulations were to verify the practical feasibility of the algorithm.
The algorithm has been applied to real scenes that include transparent objects.
The shapes of the objects were recovered with high accuracy.
entities: shapes and the poses of transparent objects
